title: Review file (review-<scope>-<date>.json; filed unchanged in reviews/inbox/)
description: docs/04 § Content review loop › The review file. Written by the review page (M1.3) and the app's review mode (M6.10); imported by content review-import (M1.13). `files` maps each reviewed file to the hash of the version shown (the approval hash; for docs/13, the hash of its content-questions section). The page also records `elements`, a fingerprint of every element it showed, so `review-export --since` can mark what changed.

elements.description: Review pages only: element target → fingerprint of what the page showed (itcontent.review.fingerprint).

additionalProperties.x-message: '{value}' is not an element fingerprint (16 hex digits)

scope.x-message: '{value}' is not a review scope (specs, assessments or uNN)

path.x-message: '{value}' is not a content file path like content/units/02-al-bar/lesson-1.yaml (or docs/13-decisions.md for the content questions)

hash.x-message: '{value}' is not an approval hash (sha256 hex, docs/04 § Approval hash)

commentFields.description: The fields of one comment, shared with the ledger (review-ledger.schema.json).

category.description: The keys of itcontent.review.CATEGORIES (and the app's ReviewComment.Category); a test keeps the three in step.
category.x-message: '{value}' is not a review category (allowed: italian-error, naturalness, level, answer-key, hint-or-rule, english, culture-or-facts, audio, other)

adjudication.description: Answers to adjudicate (task M8.3): the teacher's decision on a rejected learner answer (`response`). `near` adds it as a near-miss with `hint` (`outcome: almost` when it is nearly right); `intent` picks the conversation intent it belongs to; `count` is how often learners gave it.

outcome.x-message: '{value}' is not a near-miss outcome (almost or null)

reopens.description: The id of an earlier comment the teacher reopened on a --since page.
